title: Beat 234 - Oracle
description: A pale, hairless figure sits barefoot in a cracked metallic throne at the center of a decaying, arched chamber. The figure is connected by wires to old computer equipment on a stone pedestal and a keyboard on their lap, surrounded by radiation warning symbols, torn posters, vines, and scattered tarot cards under dramatic spotlight illumination.
prompt: A pale bald person with wires connected to their body sits in a broken metallic throne inside a decaying arched room covered in radiation trefoil symbols and torn posters. Old CRT monitors and keyboards rest on a classical pedestal beside them, tarot cards and vines scattered on the floor, dramatic spotlight from above casting strong shadows, dark surreal atmosphere, painted in realistic detail
